Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production animation sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 separate full-body drawings of Yuki, transparent background, generous clear gutters, no labels. Image 1 is the character identity and outfit reference: preserve the silver hair, red eyes, black hoodie, orange XLink geometric chest emblem, proportions and clean shading. Images 2–4 are ONLY pose/motion references from a dance; do not copy their character or costume. Match their asymmetric outstretched raised arms: viewer-left arm reaches upward and forward with its hand above the head; viewer-right arm reaches forward near the face, fingers near cheek/eyes. Both shoulders and elbows stay almost stationary throughout. Animate a rapid loose WRIST SHAKE: sharply alternate drooping spread fingers, wrist cocked sideways, fingers briefly lifted, drooping again. No whole-arm sweeps. Simultaneously HEAD SHAKES left-right around neck with small alternating 8-degree tilts, squeezed cheerful eyes during shake, long hair follows minimally. 12 ordered frames read left-to-right/top-to-bottom depict THREE repeated short wrist/head shake beats, four phases per beat, with slightly different finger arrangements. Body/legs stay fixed, every full-body drawing same scale/baseline. Neck visible and anatomy coherent. Preserve outfit/brand, constant lighting and hair shadows. No spinning, no back views, no motion-blur ghost limbs. This is a wholesome cartoon desktop companion dance.

No squeezed-shut eyes, no winking, no closed-eye faces in any cell. Preserve precisely all existing raised arm poses, wrist/finger gestures, head tilts, body, proportions, hair, constant shading, black branded hoodie with orange XLink emblem, grid layout, frame scale and transparent background. Keep the full 12-frame drawings otherwise unchanged.

Every character complete and separated with transparent gutters. No back views, no spinning, no extra limbs, no background, no blur. Wholesome playful wrist-and-head shaking desktop character.

motionBridges.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Animation in-between drawing sheet for Yuki. Input is a reference board with 4 columns and 3 rows; EACH CELL contains TWO endpoint poses, left A and right B. Produce exactly 12 SINGLE full-body in-between drawings in a 4-column 3-row grid, one drawing per cell corresponding to that input cell. Each output is the halfway anatomical pose between that cell's two endpoints, not a copy of either endpoint. Interpolate arm placement, elbow bending, leg stance, knee bend, head tilt, hand placement. Example first cell: midway rising from squat to standing, knees partly bent. Cell2: arm halfway between stretched sideways and touching face. Cell3: halfway from sideways pointing to centered hands. Cell4: half squat with arms descending. Cells5/6: hands midway through lowering, knees partly flexing. Cell7/8/9: arms halfway between side gesture/face gesture and centered hands. Cell10: halfway from leaning sideways point to upright point. Cell11: arm halfway through lowering face salute. Cell12: hands halfway lowering from chest fists to relaxed. Preserve SAME silver-haired red-eyed character, black hoodie, precise orange geometric XLink chest emblem, chibi proportions, clean linework and fixed hair shadows. Character must be upright/coherent, neck attached, hands visible, fingers anatomically clean, no rig-like disconnected limbs. Exactly 12 full-body sprites, same consistent scale and baseline, ample transparent gutters. No endpoint pairs in output, no captions, no background, no motion blur, no double images. Existing closed-eye endpoints may transition to open eyes naturally. This is wholesome desktop dance animation.

cadence.method: Adjacent full-body image difference on 96x104 previews, bounded by 20th/85th positive-difference percentiles.
cadence.adjustment: Small follow-up: -10ms at low-change end, +10ms at high-change end.
